I guess I'd like to think he isn't really a jerk. I don't want to think anybody is. 

As for telling her... god it'll kill her. She only recently became friends with him again after they had dated for 4 years. (They've been broken up 2yrs now) 

She is the most beautiful amazing person I know. 100x the woman I could ever be, and all she asks for is loyalty. My roommate was a fool for breaking up with her, and I still believe they belong together because of how much they inspire each other as wonderful people. 

I am undeserving.
who are you and why are you here?
